evidence: The chemical composition and impurity content were analyzed by RBS, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and time-of-flight secondary-ion mass spectroscopy (TOF SIMS). XPS measurements were performed with a Quantum 2000 from Phi. TOF SIMS analysis was performed with an Ion TOF-IV instrument. RBS was performed with an RBS400 Endstation. Part of the electrical characterization of Hf-based films was done using a KLA-TENCOR Quantox noncontact electrical metrology tool using corona bias. Also, MOS capacitors... The capacitance voltage (C-V) curves taken either on MOS capacitors or from Quantox were analyzed with the Hauser program.
